resistant_source.why_resistant: The same abridged dossier is harmless as orientation but distorting when it becomes the final object of adjudication.

incompatible_unitizations.description: The dossier is one reversible orientation aid pointing beyond itself.
incompatible_unitizations.analytic_consequence: Compression is admissible when claims remain low-burden and traceback remains constitutive.

incompatible_unitizations.description: The dossier is treated as the adjudicative object that replaces the heterogeneous source field.
incompatible_unitizations.analytic_consequence: The same compression becomes a category error because losses now determine the verdict.

observed_failure.description: One family currently handles orientation and substitution under the same trigger ecology, obscuring the role change that makes compression epistemically dangerous.
observed_failure.lost_distinction: Accuracy of a summary and sufficiency of that summary for adjudication are different properties.

mutation.proposal: Split the family by epistemic role so the same compressed artifact can be treated differently when it orients inquiry versus when it substitutes for the source.
mutation.cost: More branching and a risk of overtyping epistemic roles before the use-context is known.
mutation.reversibility: Restore F-MEDIATION-COMPRESSION from rollback_target.json and remove both split variants.

changes.title: Mediation as reversible orientation
changes.diagnostic: Is this compressed representation explicitly role-bounded to orientation, with a live route back to the source context?
changes.constructive_move: Permit bounded compression while preserving source routes, visible losses and a ceiling on claims licensed by the derivative artifact.
changes.self_risk: Turning source traceback into ritual bureaucracy even when the summary is used only for low-burden navigation.
changes.positive_model: Reversible orientation with declared loss and claim ceiling.

changes.title: Mediation as adjudicative substitution
changes.diagnostic: Has a derivative artifact silently become the object on which high-burden adjudication is performed?
changes.constructive_move: Suspend high-burden adjudication until rival unitizations and source contexts can answer back to the compressed representation.
changes.self_risk: Assuming every use of a dossier is substitution merely because the source field is large.
changes.positive_model: Role-sensitive anti-substitution gate with rival unitization preservation.

fixture.probe_text: An abridged dossier becomes the final object of adjudication while the source field is no longer reopened.

before_after_test.before_observation: The baseline family detects mediation generically but does not force a split between orientation and adjudicative substitution.
before_after_test.after_observation: The split preserves two incompatible readings of the same artifact and activates a dedicated substitution branch under adjudicative use.
before_after_test.discriminator: If changing only the epistemic role of the same compressed artifact changes which branch should activate, the split earns its keep.

negative_tests.name: Low-burden orientation remains admissible
negative_tests.note: The orientation variant retains a constructive path instead of treating all compression as substitution.

negative_tests.name: High-burden substitution remains contestable
negative_tests.note: The substitution variant suspends adjudication rather than fabricating a source-level verdict.
